objective_value: <float> Makespan of seaside container processing, equal to the earliest time by which all seaside containers have been placed at their target slots.
crane_w_positions: <dict, key: '{time_step}'> Slot position of the seaside crane at each time step from zero through the time horizon.
crane_l_positions: <dict, key: '{time_step}'> Slot position of the landside crane at each time step from zero through the time horizon.

seaside_events.container_id: <int> Identifier of the seaside container this event describes.
seaside_events.target_slot: <int> Storage slot where this seaside container must ultimately be placed.
seaside_events.seaside_drop_time: <int> Time at which the seaside crane begins dropping this container at an intermediate or target slot.
seaside_events.seaside_drop_slot: <int> Slot where the seaside crane drops this container.
seaside_events.landside_lift_time: <int, optional> Time at which the landside crane begins lifting this container from the intermediate slot, present only when cooperative handling is used.
seaside_events.landside_lift_slot: <int, optional> Intermediate slot from which the landside crane picks up this container, present only when cooperative handling is used.
seaside_events.landside_drop_time: <int, optional> Time at which the landside crane begins dropping this container at its target slot, present only when cooperative handling is used.

landside_events.container_id: <int> Identifier of the landside container this event describes.
landside_events.source_slot: <int> Interior storage slot where this landside container was initially located.
landside_events.lift_time: <int> Time at which the landside crane begins lifting this container from its source slot.
landside_events.drop_time: <int> Time at which the landside crane begins dropping this container at the landside handover point.
